Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce kashi 67% na matasan sun yi karatun firamare, a yayin da kashi 30.6% na da sakandare ko kuma na ilimi na gaba da sakandare.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore 67% tša bafsa ba be ba phethile thuto ya poraemari, mola 30.6% ba be ba phethile thuto ya sekontari goba ya godimo.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች 67% ወጣቶች የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ትምህርት የነበራቸው ሲሆን 30.6% ያህሉ የሁለተኛ እና የከፍተኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ነበራቸው ብለዋል፡፡

Source: 77.1% of the participants were female.
Luganda: Ebitundu 77.1% eby’abeetabi baali bakazi.
Yoruba: 77.1% àwọn akópa ni wọ́n jẹ́ obìnrin.
Zulu: Ama-77.1% ababambiqhaza bekungabesifazane.
Hausa: Kashi 77.1% na mahalarta mata ne.
Northern Sotho: 77.1% ya bakgathatema e be e le basadi.
Amharic: 77.1% ያህሉ ተሳታፊዎች ሴቶች ነበሩ፡፡

Source: Their results showed that 45.9% of the youth had never been tested for HIV.
Luganda: Bye baazuula byalaga nti ebitundu 45.9% eby’abavubuka baali tebeekebezanga ku HIV.
Yoruba: Èsì wọn fi hàn pé 45.9% àwọn ọ̀dó ni wọn ò tíì ṣe àyẹ̀wò HIV rí.
Zulu: Imiphumela yabo iveze ukuthi ama-45.9% entsha awakaze ahlolelwe i-HIV.
Hausa: Sakamakonsu ya nuna cewa kashi 45.9% na matasan ba a taɓa yi musu gwajin cutar HIV ba.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tša bona di laeditše gore 45.9% tša bafsa ga se nke ba dira diteko tša HIV.
Amharic: ውጤቶቻቸው 45.9% ያህል ወጣቶች ለኤችአይቪ ተመርምረው እንደማያውቁ ያሳያሉ፡፡

Source: The youth also had poor knowledge about HIV.
Luganda: Abavubuka era baali bamanyi kitono ku bikwata ku HIV.
Yoruba: Àwọn ọ̀dọ́ náà ol tún ní ìmọ̀ tó yèkoro nípa HIV.
Zulu: Intsha nayo ibinolwazi oluncane nge-HIV.
Hausa: Matasan kuma suna da ƙarancin ilimi game da cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Bafsa ba be ba hloka tsebo ye e lekanetšego mabapi le HIV.
Amharic: በተጨማሪ ወጣቶች ስለኤችአይቪ ያላቸው እወቀት ደካማ ነበር፡፡

Source: More than 55.5% of youth listened to the radio at least once a week, while only 9.81% read newspapers at least once a week.
Luganda: Ebitundu ebisoboba mu 55.5% eby’abavubuka baali bawuliriza leediyo waakiri omulundi gumu mu wiiki, so ng’ebitundu 9.81% bokka be baasomanga amawulire waakiri omulundi gumu mu wiiki.
Yoruba: Àwọn ọ̀dọ́ tó ju 55.5% lọ ló ń tẹ́tí sí èrọ asọ̀rọ̀mágbèsì ní ó kéré jù ẹ̀ẹ̀kan lọ́sẹ̀, tí 9.81% nìkan ń ka ìwé-ìròyìn ló kéré jù ẹ̀ẹ̀kan lọ́sẹ̀.
Zulu: Intsha engaphezu kwama-55.5% ilalela umsakazo okungenani kanye ngesonto, kanti ama-9.81% kuphela afunda amaphephandaba okungenani kanye ngesonto.
Hausa: Fiye da kashi 55.5% na matasan suna sauraron rediyo aƙalla sau ɗaya a mako, a yayin da kashi 9.81% kaɗai suke karanta jaridu aƙalla sau ɗaya a mako.
Northern Sotho: Go feta 55.5% tša bafsa ba be ba theeletša radio bonnyane gatee mo bekeng, mola 9.81% fela ba be ba bala dikuranta gatee mo bekeng.
Amharic: ከ55.5% በላይ ወጣቶች ቢያንስ በሳምንት አንዴ ሬዲዮ ያዳምጣሉ፤ 9.81% ደግሞ ቢያንስ በሳምንት አንድ ጊዜ ጋዜጣዎችን ያነባሉ፡፡

Source: Only 20.5% had access to television at least once a week.
Luganda: Ebitundu 20.5% bokka be baalabanga ttivvi waakiri omulundi gumu mu wiiki.
Yoruba: 20.5% nìkan ni ẹ̀rọ amóhùn-máwòrán ní àrọ́wọ́tó wọn ní ó kéré jù ẹ̀ẹ̀kan lọ́sẹ̀.
Zulu: Bangama-20.5% kuphela ababekwazi ukuthola umabonakude okungenani kanye ngesonto.
Hausa: Kashi 20.5% ne kawai suke samun damar kallon talabijin aƙalla sau ɗaya a mako.
Northern Sotho: Ke fela 20.5% tša bao ba bego ba kgona go bogela thelebišene gatee mo bekeng.
Amharic: 20.5% ያህሉ ብቻ ቢያንስ በሳምንት አንድ ጊዜ ቴሌቪዥን የማየት እድል ያገኛሉ፡፡

Source: The researchers said their results suggested that being exposed to media increased their chances of getting tested for HIV, and led to better HIV-related knowledge.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti bye baazuula byalaga nti okukozesa emikutu gy’amawulire kyayongera abantu emikisa gy’okwekebeza HIV, n’okubasobozesa okwongera okumanya ebikwata ku HIV.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà sọ pé àwọn èsì wọn dábàá pé ṣísírasílẹ̀ sí ìmẹ̀rọ oníròyìn ń ṣàfikún àwọn àyè à ti ṣàyẹ̀wò fún HIV, èyí tí yóó ṣún wọn sí ìmọ̀ tó kún si nípa HIV.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathe imiphumela yabo iphakamisa ukuthi ukuvezwa kwezokuxhumana kwandisa amathuba abo okuhlolelwa i-HIV, nokuholela olwazini olungcono oluhlobene ne-HIV.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce sakamakon nasu ya nuna cewa saninsu ga kafafen yaɗa labarai yana kara musu damar yin gwajin cutar HIV, kuma ya kai ga samun ingantaccen ilimin da yake da nasaba da cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore dipoelo tša bona di šišintše gore go kgona go theeletša bobegaditaba go okeditše dibaka tša bona tša go dirwa diteko tša HIV, le go ba le tsebo ye kaone ye e amanago le HIV.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንደሚሉት ውጤቶቻቸው ለሚዲያ ተጋላጭ መሆን ለኤችአይቪ የመመርመር እድላቸውን እንደሚጨምር እና የተሻለ ከኤችአይቪ ጋር የተያያዘ እውቀትን እንደሚያመጣ ይገልጻለ፡፡

Source: Reading newspapers once a week increased chances of getting tested for HIV by 6.29%, and listening to the radio once a week by 4.57%.
Luganda: Okusoma empapula z’amawulire waakiri omulundi gumu mu wiiki kyayongera ku mikisa gy’okwekebeza HIV ebitundu 6.29%, so ng’okuwuliriza leediyo omulundi gumu mu wiiki kyayongera emikisa ebitundu 4.57%.
Yoruba: Kíka àwọn ìwé-ìròyìn lẹ́ẹ̀kan lọ́sẹ̀ ṣàgbéga àwọn àyè à ti ṣàyèwò HIV pẹ̀lú 6.29%, àti títẹ́tí sí èrọ asọ̀rọ̀mágbèsì lẹ́ẹ̀kan lọ́sẹ̀ pẹ̀lú 4.57%.
Zulu: Ukufunda amaphephandaba kanye ngesonto kwenyuse amathuba okuhlolelwa i-HIV ngama-6.29%, nokulalela umsakazo kanye ngesonto ngama-4.57%.
Hausa: Karatun jaridu sau ɗaya a mako yana haɓaka damar yin gwajin cutar HIV da kashi 6.29%, da sauraron rediyo sau ɗaya a mako da kashi 4.57%.
Northern Sotho: Go bala dikuranta gatee mo bekeng go okeditše dibaka tša go dirwa diteko tša HIV ka 6.29%, le go theeletša radio gatee mo bekeng ka 4.57%.
Amharic: ጋዜጣዎችን በሳምንት አንድ ጊዜ ማንበብ ለኤችአይቪ የመመርመር እድላቸውን በ6.29% የሚጨምር ሲሆን ሬዲዮ በሳምንት አንዴ መስማት ደግሞ በ4.57% ይጨምረዋል፡፡

Source: They said those who listened to the radio more than once a week were even more likely to test.
Luganda: Baagamba nti abo abaawuliriza leediyo emirundi egisukka mu gumu mu wiiki baalina emikisa egisingawo egy’okwekebeza.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ní ̀wọn tó tẹ́tí sí èrọ asọ̀rọ̀mágbèsì ju ẹ̀ẹ̀kan lọ́sẹ̀ lọ ṣeẹ́ṣe jù fún láti ṣàyèwò.
Zulu: Bathe abalalela umsakazo izikhathi ezingaphezu kwesisodwa ngesonto maningi amathuba okuthi bahlole.
Hausa: Sun ce waɗanda suke sauraron rediyo fiye da sau ɗaya a mako sun ma fi yin gwajin.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore bao ba theeleditšego radio go feta gatee mo bekeng go be go na le kgonagalo ye ntši ya gore ba ka dirwa diteko.
Amharic: በሳምንት ከአንድ ጊዜ በላይ ሬዲዮ የሚያዳምጡ ሰዎች የመመርመር እድላቸው የበለጠ ከፍተኛ እንደሆነ ተናግረዋል፡፡

Source: The researchers also found out that those who watched TV more than once a week were 8.57% more likely to get tested for HIV.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baakizuula nti abo abalaba ttivvi emirundi egisukka mu gumu mu wiiki baali basuubirwa okwekebeza HIV ebitundu 8.57% okusinga ku balala.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí tún ri pé àwọn tó ń wo TV ju ẹ̀ẹ̀kan lọ́sẹ̀ tó jẹ́ 8.57% ni wọ́n àyè tó ṣeéṣe jù fún à ti ṣàyẹ̀wò HIV.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphinde bathola ukuthi labo ababuka i-TV izikhathi ezingaphezu kwesisodwa ngesonto basethubeni elihle lokuhlolelwa i-HIV ngama-8.57%.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kuma gano cewa waɗanda suke kallon talabijin fiye da sau ɗaya a mako sun fi kashi 8.57% yiwuwar yin gwajin cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba hweditše le gore bao ba bego ba bogela TV go feta gatee mo bekeng ba be ba na le 8.57% tša kgonagalo ya gore ba ka dirwa diteko tša HIV.
Amharic: በተጨማሪ ተመራማሪዎች በሳምንት ከአንድ ጊዜ በላይ ቲቪ የሚያዩ ሶዎች ለኤችአይቪ የመመርመር አዝማሚያቸው በ8.57% ከፍ እንደሚል አግኝተዋል፡፡

Source: The researchers concluded that communication channels such as newspapers, radio and TV promoted healthy sexual conduct among youth in Uganda.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakomekkereza nti emikutu gy’empuliziganya nga empapula z’amawulire, leediyo ne ttivvi gitumbula enneeyisa ennungi mu byokwegatta mu bavubuka mu Uganda.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà fòpin si pé àwọn ọ̀nà ìbáraẹnisọ̀rọ̀ bíi àwọn ìwé-ìròyìn, èrọ asọ̀rọ̀mágbèsì àti TV ṣàgbéga ìlera ìbálòpò tó da láàárín àwọn ọ̀dọ́ Uganda.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphethe ngokuthi imigudu yokuxhumana efana namaphephandaba, umsakazo kanye ne-TV ikhuthaza ukuziphatha okunempilo kocansi entsheni yase-Uganda.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kammala cewa tashoshin sadarwa irin su jaridu da rediyo da TV suna inganta halayen jima'i masu kyau a tsakanin matasa a ƙasar Yuganda.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba phethile ka gore ditsela tša kgokagano tše bjalo ka dikuranta, radio le TV di hlohleleditše maitshwaro a mabotse go tša thobalano magareng ga bafsa go la Uganda.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንደ ጋዜጣዎች፣ ሬዲዮ እና ቲቪ የመሰሉ የመገናኛ ጣቢያዎች በኡጋንዳ ወጣቶች መሃል ጤነኛ ወሲባዊ ባህሪያትን እንደሚያበረታቱ ደምድመዋል፡፡

Source: They recommended more research to look at the effect of the internet and social media on youths’ sexual and reproductive health in developing countries.
Luganda: Baateesa wabeewo okunoonyereza okulala okutunuulira ebireetebwa yintaneeti n’emikutu emigattabantu ku byobulamu mu kwegatta n’okuzaala mu mawanga agakyakula.
Yoruba: Wọ́n dábàá àwọn ilwádìí si láti wo ipá ẹ̀rọ́ ayélujára àti ìkànì ìbánidórèẹ́ lórí ìlera tó níí ṣe pèlú ìbálópọ̀ àti ìbí àwọn ọ̀dọ́ ní àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tó sì ń dàgbàsókè.
Zulu: Bancome ucwaningo olwengeziwe ukuze kubhekwe umphumela we-inthanethi nezinkundla zokuxhumana empilweni yentsha yezocansi nokuzala emazweni asathuthuka.
Hausa: Sun bayar da shawarar ƙarin bincike don duba tasirin Intanet da kafafen sada zumunta a kan lafiyar matasa na jima'i da haihuwa a ƙasashe masu tasowa.
Northern Sotho: Ba šišintše gore go dirwe dinyakišišo tše ntši go lebelela seabe sa inthanete le dikgokagano tša leago go tshedimošo ka tša thobalano le ditho tša pelego tša bafsa ka dinageng tše di hlabologago.
Amharic: በታዳጊ ሃገሮች የወጣቶች ወሲባዊ እና የስነ-ተዋልዶ ጤና ላይ የኢንተርኔትን ተጽእኖ ለማየት ተጨማሪ ምርምሮች መደረግ እንዳለባቸው ይመክራሉ፡፡
